sites.name: Chavín de Huántar
sites.era: ancient (era not stated in the tariff annex)
sites.what: Archaeological monument at Chavín de Huántar, with the Museo Nacional Chavín nearby.

access.tickets: Monument: S/15 general, S/5 students, S/2 minors. Museo Nacional Chavín: S/10 general, S/5 students, S/2 minors. Free on Tuesdays for registered residents of Chavín de Huántar district. 50% concessions as for other ministry sites. (No RBA rate for PEN; at the Banco Central de Reserva del Perú rate of 30 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 2.4408 PEN: S/15 ≈ A$6.15; S/5 ≈ A$2.05; S/2 ≈ A$0.82; S/10 ≈ A$4.10)

sources.title: Series PD04640PD, SBS selling rate, 30 Oct 2026
